items.note: S1.1 states the lemma (y_S += x_S for arbitrary scratch, three stages give (X,Y)->(-Y,X) restoring scratch), and S1.1.1-S1.1.5 follow the proof at 744-764: rows cancel Ja+Rc, the net change is (JV+RG)x, the bit and complex central coefficients, then the three-stage composition. The construction constants (h=100, neighbour rules, wire counts W_b, W_c at 767-782) are not given, but the lemma's argument is complete.

It has the invariant (stored = D_v applied to the logical array), commutation of a shared frame with a pointwise gate by R-linearity, the sandwich D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the per-route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, exactly as at 804-825.

It states the nondegenerate labels in F^{(x)3} of dimension m, nesting on edges, the single decrease (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539, 101/539. The telescoping and counting follow 1066-1071. The gate-label table (975-988) and the edge residual table (1022-1043), which carry the comparability check, are only referred to, and the central-wire mechanism (A(x)F on the X bank, B(x)F on the Y bank) is missing. So the derivation is partial.

It has the projection assignment with -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the 2P_{U_a} exception, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and the endpoint differences I_m on every role, as at 1156-1171. The shear H<-H+D on every role through Phi_M frames is reached in S2.2.3-S2.2.4.

It states the kernel factorization, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and C^{(x)m} on every role, but never defines the phase frames C_U=H^{(x)m} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{(x)m}. The key mechanism at 1232-1257 is absent: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight of norm-one v, and the Hadamard conversion of i^{eps[v.x]} to aI+bX_v. S1.6.1 only restates the proposition. The X_a->Y_a repair (S1.6.4) is faithful.

It gives s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m from L<N/2, eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and the exponential inequality giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, following 1331-1344. The exact eta values are not reproduced, but the inequality actually used is.

Steps invoke 'the controlled shifts lemma' and cyclic row splitting, and the plan lists stream-ops and controlled-shifts as dependencies. The elementary-stream and controlled-shift lemmas are never stated with their content (O(V) for digit moves and splits, offsets prepared in b^{O(1)}).

It has the A=E_1 Pi E_2 pivot elimination (topmost row, rightmost entry), triangular transforms in O(V) by descending-order updates, and the one-interchange realization D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j, so exactly a interchanges. This matches 1375-1446.

It covers every step of 1491-1615: cyclic row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} on edges via recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the merge undoing rho, three shears to a swap, s calls on V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule.

It follows 1649-1762: high digits as a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces with an O(Ve^tau) geometric sum, padding binary ranges to [q^e], and the one-bit-difference case.

It has the edge frame change as a product over a residual basis, conjugation by P_M to coordinate slots, child calls (C^{eps})^{(x)f} with the inverse identity (-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on e/m axes, the reduction of P_M to a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D, as at 1835-1940.

It has the eight-operation cycles giving a parity flip with w restored, packed cyclic shifts, guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, correction by extraction and radix sort, the final two-bit XOR, and the cost. This matches 2013-2207.

It has the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first chunks sent to roles with V/W child volume, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) for e<d^beta, the internal and leaf sums, and base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}), as at 2286-2445.

It states the layer on D<=d chunks, O(Vd^{lambda'}) and error <sqrt2 2^{-p}, with exact evaluation and one final truncation. S3.5 states the guard bound ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) but not how it is obtained: the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and its unrolling (2479-2560) are missing. The uniformity check of the packed cost (A_*<=C_A p, K>=6, 2696-2735) is also missing.

It has character cancellation via y^{rj_0}=-1, DIF with bit-reversed storage, the reverse procedure, grouped rounds, prefix moves, chunk exchanges, the per-round layer cost, monomials as split and swap, the error accumulation, and the exact operators LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, all as in the paper.

It has evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four signed products, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred extraction with a carry in {0,1}, negacyclic reduction, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, as at 3233-3367.

It has the retained LB order (pointwise products commute with record permutations), the normalization identity M F^+(F^-f F^-g/r)=(f*g)/(rM), the error 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M, and the cost, matching 3414-3494.

It has the HvdH identity and Neumann inverse, A=S', B_0=D'J'C with scale product 2^{-2alpha^2}, the cited ordered maps, permutations left in the identity, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, the line-count cost, and axis exposure O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)), as in the paper.

It has the chirp periodicity, coefficient comparison for QF_t, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, RF^+R=F^+, and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, exactly as at 3938-3982. Conjugation for RF^+ appears in S6.5.5.

The parameter values and size choices are stated correctly, and the prime-interval argument (4110-4171) is derived faithfully. The check that the fixed parameters satisfy all layer conditions (4016-4036), the derivation of the sizes Tp=Theta(n) etc. (4073-4088), and alpha's definition and the gamma=o(b) bound are not shown.

It has the algebra map and isomorphism argument, the triangular mixed-radix formula, the update order d..1, padding preservation, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the O(d^2) axis moves, as at 4216-4292.

It has well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism preserving norms, the wrap computation zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, computed phases within 2*2^{-p}, and the twist and untwist sequence with truncations. S6.7.1 gives the phase-product error below 4h_p.

It has the source transform composition with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 QF_t A=RF_s, the conjugate opposite procedure, the pointwise product, and the two scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S, each tied to its normalization. Rounding, Phi^{-1} and carries are covered in S6 and S6.7.

It chains E_ring<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, z error (2E_s+2), E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries, matching 4591-4727. Writing gamma=o(b) for the paper's gamma<=b/4 is acceptable for the eventual bound.

It has the cost table rows with their powers, the margins g_1..g_7, min=g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff, as in the paper. The argument that setup across recursion visits and exceptional-address sorting are o(V) (4913-4981) is missing.
S0.1 states the eventual lower bound, its negation by liminf=0, and that the power saving gives limit zero, as at 381-387. The paper has no further derivation.

errors.says: For triple indicator vectors <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1, so every triple line is nondegenerate and neighbouring lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction (the S1.3 method also attributes the orthogonality to the pairing |S cap T|-1).
errors.paper: The pairing |S cap T|-1 (with <t_T,t_T>=2) holds for the bit network's rational form x^T(I-J/9)y on Q^h. The complex network instead uses F_2^h with the ordinary dot product, where t_T.t_T=1 and orthogonality comes from even intersection. Only the conclusion is stated for both.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It runs from the scalar exchange network, frames, labels and rank budget (S1), through the bit interface and the interchange recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} (S2), the complex phase interface and butterfly-layer recurrence (S3), and synthetic transforms, resampling, the chirp identity, CRT, exact recovery and the cost table (S4-S7). It thins out in a few places. The network's constants (h=100, triple indexing, N, m, wire counts) are never given. The complex phase interface lacks its weight-additivity and Hadamard mechanism. The guard-width depth recurrence is only asserted, and the time accounting omits the o(V) setup and exceptional-sorting argument.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated and derived. The defining construction is missing: h=100, data pairs indexed by triples a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear (S1.3 only mentions three-element subsets).
It gives the common frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the D_out S D_in^{-1} identity, and that only endpoint frames matter, so edges merely change frame, as in the paper.
It has nondegenerate subspaces of F^{(x)3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h.
It has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
It has the telescoping to Wm-2N, plus 2L with L=Ich, plus N source ranks, giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, and s<Wm for both networks.
It has M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} on X_a, 0 to I elsewhere), so the network applies H<-H+D on every original row, scratch rows included.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular factors in O(V), one interchange per one of Pi, hence exactly a recursive interchanges per edge and s calls per node.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta>20*2^{-50} with log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau for tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric sum to F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, the budget, the strict saving L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear, edges as recursive interchanges and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} are all present with their defining quantities. The one gap is the fixed network's concrete data. The plan never says h=100, that data is indexed by triples with N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3, so C1 is only mentioned.
